svg.title: Message cleanup and tidy-specific tags
svg.desc: Message cleanup and tidy tags move into finalizeDiagnostic(), after notes and fixes are assembled. Constructor errors get tidy metadata here because they precede check initialization. Cleanup still covers messages, notes and fixes; containment checks avoid duplicate tags.
svg.text: Message cleanup and tidy tags move into finalizeDiagnostic(), after notes and fixes are assembled.
// clang-tidy bakes the name into diagnostic messages. Strip it out.
// It would be much nicer to make clang-tidy not do this.
Constructor errors get tidy metadata here because they precede check initialization.
Cleanup still covers messages, notes and fixes; containment checks avoid duplicate tags.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
